text: brahmacariyaphalāni . sotāpattiphalaṃ sakadāgāmiphalaṃ anāgāmiphalaṃ arahattaphalaṃ . imāni vuccanti bhikkhave brahmacariyaphalānīti . [114] sāvatthīnidānaṃ . brahmacariyañca vo bhikkhave desissāmi brahmacariyatthañca taṃ suṇātha . [115] katamañca bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ . ayamevāriyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo . seyyathīdaṃ . sammādiṭṭhi .pe. sammāsamādhi . idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ . [116] katamo ca bhikkhave brahmacariyattho . yo ca 1 bhikkhave rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo . ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave brahmacariyatthoti . paṭipattivaggo catuttho . tassuddānaṃ paṭipatti paṭipanno ca viraddhañca 2 pāraṃ gamā sāmaññena [3] deva vuttā brahmaññā apare duve brahmacariyena deva vuttā vaggo tena pavuccatīti . _____________ #1
